mlir_version:
Naru 0.2.0 - extensible AOT compiler with in-process MLIR/LLVM/LLD
naru parse|check|emit <file.nru> --rules <file.stx> [--rules ...]
naru eval --rules <file.stx> --expr 'relation(Term(...))'
naru build <file.nru> --rules <file.stx> -o <artifact> [--target mlir|exe|profile.json]
naru opt <file.mlir> -o <artifact> [--target mlir|bytecode|llvm-ir|object|exe|profile.json]
naru freeze --rules <file.stx> -o <specialized.vyx>
Options: --entry item --relation emit --project Naru.toml --pass-pipeline PIPELINE
         --irdl FILE --dialect-plugin DLL --pass-plugin DLL --backend-library DLL
         --native-entry main --triple TRIPLE --cpu CPU --features FEATURES --opt-level 0|1|2|3|s|z
emit verifies MLIR; build optimizes and emits entirely in process.

tests.detail: Embedded MLIR -> LLVM -> TargetMachine -> LLD executable exits 42 under a no-child-process Job
2 loops -> 1; temporary allocation, deallocation, load and store eliminated
Registered IRDL operations and custom f32 tile type preserved in a non-LLVM artifact
IRDL verifier rejects wrong operand type; existing output is not replaced
Device program is rejected without its dialect registration
Unknown pass cannot silently fall back to an unoptimized build
Device workgroups IntegerAttr is accepted; a string attribute is rejected
9 output/report input collisions rejected, including target, IRDL, plugins and a hard-linked report path
